const m = $input.first().json;

const metrics = [
  { name: 'Rex - New Listings (7d)',         value: String(m.newListings) },
  { name: 'Rex - New Enquiries (7d)',         value: String(m.newEnquiries) },
  { name: 'Rex - Total Active Buyers',        value: String(m.activeBuyers) },
  { name: 'Rex - Listings Under Offer (7d)',  value: String(m.underOffer) },
  { name: 'Rex - Inspections Last 7d',        value: String(m.inspections) },
  { name: 'Rex - Appraisals Booked Sale',     value: String(m.apprSale) },
  { name: 'Rex - Appraisals Booked Rental',   value: String(m.apprRental) },
  { name: 'Rex - Appraisals Attended',        value: String(m.apprAttended) },
  { name: 'Rex - Listings Won Sale (7d)',      value: String(m.wonSale) },
  { name: 'Rex - Listings Won Rental (7d)',    value: String(m.wonRental) },
  { name: 'Rex - Listings Over 30d',          value: String(m.listings30d) },
  { name: 'Rex - Last Updated',               value: m.dateStr },
  { name: 'Rex - Weekly Summary',             value: m.summary }
];

return metrics.map(item => ({ json: item }));
